class.name: OrderIndependentTransparencyGeometryRelay
class.brief_description: Path A geometry helper that feeds transparent meshes to an [OrderIndependentTransparencyCompositorEffect].
class.description: Traverses child [MeshInstance3D] nodes (or the explicit list in [member mesh_paths]) every frame, packs their POSITION streams and per-instance albedo/world_transform into byte buffers, uploads them to shared SSBOs, and emits [signal transparency_batches_ready] for the compositor effect to consume on its next callback. [b]Caveat:[/b] Path A duplicates transparent vertex data on the GPU because it re-submits the geometry outside of Godot's normal render list. A future engine hook (Path B) would let engine-managed transparent surfaces flow through the compositor effect without this duplication; see the module README for the planned surface-skip flag.

method.name: repack_now
method.description: Forces a rescan of the target meshes and emits [signal transparency_batches_ready] with the resulting batch descriptors.

members.member: Optional [NodePath] to the [OrderIndependentTransparencyCompositorEffect] that should consume this relay. When unset, the relay only emits the signal and any listener may connect.
When [code]true[/code], the relay re-packs its batches whenever the child count changes. Set to [code]false[/code] for static scenes and call [method repack_now] manually.
Explicit list of node paths (relative to the relay) to include. Overrides the default child-traversal when non-empty.

signal.name: transparency_batches_ready
signal.description: Emitted after a repack. [code]batches[/code] is an [Array] of per-mesh descriptor [Dictionary]s consumed by the compositor effect.
